event.description: Factor attention output projection through rank 4
event.proposal: family: attention organization; retained incumbent is 3776 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0015, shared K/V attention at 3776/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0016, shared Q plus K/V at 3520/0.02%; prior attempts in this family: 2. Hypothesis: retain distinct queries and shared K/V from the accepted MQA model, but factor each post-attention output projection as d16->4->d16, reducing 256 full-rank parameters to 128 per block and yielding 3520 parameters. This is more informative than repeating query sharing because it preserves head-specific attention scores and tests a different low-rank location. Keep learned positions, reversed operands, ff20, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3776 parameters.
